title: The Labyrinth of Ancient Shadows
author: Matheus Valente
description: A dangerous journey through the catacombs of the Forgotten Temple, where choices lead to fortune and survival.

sections.text: You stand before the corrupted iron gates of the Forgotten Temple. A dense fog wraps around your boots and the sound of dragging chains echoes from within.

options.description: Force the main gate open and rush inside
options.tip: It might be a bit rough, but it's direct.

consequence.text: The rusty gate gives way abruptly, giving you a minor scrape.

options.description: Look for a discreet side entrance

consequence.text: You find a hidden path and feel a sudden surge of renewed energy.

sections.text: You enter the main hall. Headless statues flank the dark corridor stretching out before you.

options.description: Follow the central corridor lit by magical torches
options.tip: It seems like the fastest way.

consequence.text: The magic in the torches revitalizes your body and spirit.

options.description: Examine the base of one of the statues

consequence.text: A minor dart trap goes off, but you dodge most of it with a tiny scratch.

sections.text: You bypass the wall and find a narrow crevice leading into a dusty pantry of the temple.

options.description: Search the ancient food jars
options.tip: Perhaps you will find something useful.

consequence.text: You find a forgotten medicinal tonic and recover your strength.

options.description: Go straight for the back door leading to the sanctuary

sections.text: The central corridor ends at a circular chamber with an unbridgeable abyss. There is a narrow stone bridge and an improvised rope zipline.

options.description: Cross the stone bridge carefully

consequence.text: Crossing safely fills you with confidence and vigor.

options.description: Use the rope zipline

consequence.text: The rope frays a bit midway, but you land safely on your feet.

sections.text: By dodging the darts, you discover a secret passage beneath the statue's floor leading down into the crypts.

options.description: Descend the spiral crypt stairs
options.tip: The air down here is freezing.

consequence.text: A warm pocket of air inside the crypt warms you up.

options.description: Return to the main hall
options.tip: Better not risk the crypt right now.

sections.text: Refreshed by the tonic, you search the pantry better and find a heavy iron key.

options.description: Use the key on the locked north door
options.tip: The key seems to fit perfectly.

options.description: Head down the dark eastern corridor

consequence.text: You discover a hidden stash of energy fruits along the way.

sections.text: You reach an underground crossroads where the smell of sulfur is strong.

options.description: Take the left tunnel where warmth radiates from

consequence.text: A brief wave of intense heat singes your cloak slightly.

options.description: Take the right tunnel with a fresh breeze
options.tip: Fresh air is a good sign.

consequence.text: The refreshing breeze clears your mind and restores your stamina.

sections.text: You cross the bridge successfully and find a glowing magical water fountain in the center of the next room.

options.description: Drink from the fountain water

consequence.text: The sacred water heals all your recent fatigue and wounds.

options.description: Ignore the fountain and keep walking

sections.text: Despite the slight stumble, you manage to stand up and spot a large carved wooden door ahead.

options.description: Push the wooden door open
options.tip: Time to face what lies inside.

consequence.text: An inspiring aura behind the door boosts your confidence.

options.description: Inspect the side carvings on the wall

sections.text: In the crypts, open tombs reveal the remains of ancient temple priests.

options.description: Search the funeral altars for relics
options.tip: Desecration might have a high price.

consequence.text: A minor guardian spirit strikes you before fading away.

options.description: Walk through the crypt silently without touching anything

consequence.text: Peaceful silence calms your nerves, restoring your health.

sections.text: The eastern corridor opens up into an abandoned armorage filled with rusted shields and broken spears.

options.description: Search the weapon racks for a usable dagger
options.tip: A weapon could protect you later.

consequence.text: You find a well-balanced ceremonial dagger and feel safer.

options.description: Ignore the armorage and climb up a winding staircase
options.tip: Stairs usually lead to higher levels.

sections.text: The right tunnel leads you into an indoor overgrown garden where glowing mushrooms illuminate the soil.

options.description: Harvest some glowing blue mushrooms

consequence.text: Eating a fresh mushroom soothes your sore muscles.

options.description: Cross the garden quickly toward a stone archway

sections.text: By bypassing the fountain, you enter a quiet gallery lined with ancient tapestries depicting legendary battles.

options.description: Rest against a tapestry for a brief moment
options.tip: Your feet need a short break.

consequence.text: Taking a short breather revitalizes your stamina.

options.description: Keep walking briskly down the gallery

sections.text: The wall carvings reveal a hidden mechanism that shifts a heavy stone block out of your path.

options.description: Step through the newly opened passage

consequence.text: A sudden rush of clean air clears out the stale dungeon dust.

options.description: Stay on the main path

sections.text: Fleeing the guardian spirit, you stumble into a subterranean balcony overlooking a vast cavernous hall.

options.description: Look for a safe descent ramp on the balcony
Search the balcony remnants for loose valuables

consequence.text: A loose stone crumbles under your heel, straining your ankle slightly.

sections.text: Walking silently brings you to a quiet resting nook used by ancient monks centuries ago.

options.description: Sit on the stone meditation bench

consequence.text: Deep meditation restores your mental focus and heals your body.

options.description: Check behind the stone bench

sections.text: Equipped with your findings, you reach a junction where two metallic doors face each other.

options.description: Open the left metallic door with silver engravings

consequence.text: A soft healing hum resonates from the door frame as you pass.

options.description: Open the right metallic door with bronze markings

sections.text: You climb to the upper tier of the temple structure, where daylight filters through cracks in the high ceiling.

options.description: Bask in the warm shaft of sunlight

consequence.text: The natural sunlight completely reinvigorates your tired body.

options.description: Head straight toward the illuminated exit arch

sections.text: You find yourself standing on a high stone bridge overlooking the main shrine from above.

options.description: Descend the grand marble stairs directly to the shrine
Take a side balcony path for a better vantage point

consequence.text: Getting a clear view of the layout fills you with determination.

sections.text: Navigating the final stretch of winding corridors, you hear the familiar sounds of the outside world echoing near.

options.description: Run eagerly toward the echoing sounds

consequence.text: The thrill of approaching freedom fills you with fresh energy.

options.description: Walk steadily and carefully until the very end

sections.text: The door opens to reveal the temple's central altar, where the Great Ruby is safely kept.
Overwhelmed by minor hazards and exhaustion, you reach a dead-end tunnel to rest.
The cool tunnel leads you directly to the temple's main treasure chamber.
With your energy fully renewed by the fountain, you open the golden door leading out of the cursed complex towards freedom.
You proceed cautiously and find the escape route leading you safely out of the ominous complex alive.
